thresholds.coordinates: zero-based pixels; bbox right/bottom exclusive; feet inclusive; floor exclusive
thresholds.fighter_cell_exceptions: ART-69 defeat:192/feet152; ART-68 rio_female low_sweep and dimension_slash:192/feet152, as well as victory. Others128/feet120. Six padded columns required by ART-81; legacy 1-cell Nova hurt is explicitly flagged.
thresholds.binary_alpha: fighter/monster/sheet: semi-transparent count must equal zero; faces/projectiles allow antialias
thresholds.key_green: alpha>=24, R<=40, G>=215, B<=40; any => review, not automatic proof of spill
thresholds.halo: 4-connected outer edge; light min(RGB)>=220 and max-min<=30; dark max(RGB)<=20. Review if >=20 pixels, >20% edge AND fraction exceeds identity idle/neutral by >.15. Black outlines already in anchor are not halos. Shadow darkening intentional.
thresholds.checker: 8x8 fully opaque neutral tile; RGB range<=8; parity blocks 1/2/4 px contrast>=20; residual std<=5; >=4 tiles => review
thresholds.repeated: premultiplied RGBA; exact changed-visible pixels=0 => fail; near if union-mask MAE<=2/255 AND changed>8-channel fraction<=0.03 => review; loop seam listed separately
thresholds.fighter_head: original head_scale.py: scale 0.60..1.60 step .02, score>=.60; desired .96..1.04, accepted .95..1.06; template-only deviations => review
thresholds.head_skin_locator: original unmodified mask: A>0, R>200, G>150, B>120, R>G>B, 40<R-B<110; largest 4-connected skin region. Template offsets (-18,-22,+12,+8); translation window +/-8 pixels. Wrong/occluded skin components are not reliable anatomy.
thresholds.fresh_face_proposals: ART-72/75/77 fixed feature boxes; nearest-neighbour 4x; patch search +/-6 enlarged pixels (.25 native pixel step). No automated pass threshold: proposals require landmark validation. Nova/Rio eye distances omitted because the anchor far eye is occluded.
thresholds.monster_stable_part: idle F1 crop, masked RGB NCC; scale .60..1.60 step .02, score>=.75, accepted .95..1.05; uncertain matches => review, no anatomy claim
thresholds.stable_colour_masks: A>0: moth R>190,G>170,B>210; ram/raven R>110,G>65,R>1.6B,G>1.4B; slinger R>70,R>1.35G,R>1.8B,y<48. Largest 4-connected component; ram restrict bbox y0<55,x1>50; raven choose component centre nearest (49,50), defeat (60,48). Moth/slinger sqrt(area), ram height, raven width; ratio .95..1.05.
thresholds.stable_colour_validity: Selected component area must be >=8 pixels; slinger component touching imposed y=48 cut is truncated and unusable. Raw sizes/ratios retained, but invalid selections are not scored as anatomical size defects.
thresholds.semantic_feet_roi: Only SHA-256-bound manually identified ROIs in semantic-rois.json may replace lowest-alpha proxy. Measure A>0 bottom, tolerance +/-1px and stated boundary uncertainty +/-1px.
thresholds.bbox_size: width/height/area relative to idle F1; ratios outside .75..1.25 are a screening observation, not failure (pose changes)
thresholds.palette: alpha>=128, RGB max>=40, HSV saturation>=.20; twelve 30-degree hue bins; TV > .25 AND dominant circular hue shift>=30deg => review; full luminance/channel stats also reported
thresholds.face_preservation: expressions: exact RGBA outside actual saved mask must have 0 changed pixels; all faces alpha difference=0
thresholds.shadow_offset: integer gradient NCC on ART-80 ROI, search +/-4; residual abs(dx)>1 or abs(dy)>1 or NCC<.60 => review; copied alpha cannot establish internal alignment
thresholds.metadata: frames/fps required for strips; frames positive integer and matches occupied prefix, fps finite >0, loop bool when present; missing cell/feet/loop => review (viewer may infer); sheet/portrait animation metadata NA
thresholds.all_checks_pass: all applicable check statuses pass or na; review/unmeasured excluded. Sheet content checks are propagated from per-row checks; direct pixel-assembly pass is separate.
